text:
maya: FYI onboarding sampleapp: when folks enable OTEL auto-instrumentation the app logs sometimes show `reqId: -`. Repro steps: incoming X-Request-Id present, but our loghook prints dash. Happens on mac/linux and in Docker.

sam: Interesting. Any middleware order snippets? usually req-id middleware has to run before other shims.

maya: Minimal repro:
```js
const app = express();
app.use(require('@opentelemetry/auto-instrument')()); // auto-instrumenting express
app.use(require('request-id')());
app.use(require('./redact-middleware')());
app.use(require('./loghook')());
app.get('/', (req,res)=> res.end('ok'));
```
With that ordering req.id sometimes present but log prints `-`. If I move request-id above otel it works.

evans: OTEL can wrap req/res lifecycle and run before our log hook, plus redact middleware might scrub headers early. Two vectors.

evans: Short-term fixes:
- let loghook fallback to res.getHeader('x-request-id') and req.headers['x-request-id']
- make redact allowlist for x-request-id so it's not removed under REDACT_STRICT

security: We'll need to ensure the allowlist doesn't leak PII. x-request-id is fine if we store a hashed value in logs. Recommend HMAC with service key.

maya: Patch plan:
1) hotfix loghook fallback (fast)
2) add REDACT_ALLOWLIST_HEADERS env var and wire to redact middleware (config + tests)
3) add optional HASH_ALLOWLIST_HEADERS=true so internal logs store stable hashed id instead of raw header

sam: Example fallback code we can ship now:
```js
function resolveReqId(req,res) {
  const raw = req.id || req.headers['x-request-id'] || res.getHeader('x-request-id');
  if (!raw) return '-';
  if (process.env.HASH_ALLOWLIST_HEADERS === '1') return hash(raw);
  return raw;
}
```
Quick unit test: simulate otel wrapping by replacing `req` object after request-id runs and confirm resolveReqId still returns id via header.

evans: Longer term: add an SDK init hook that installs our loghook before auto-instrumentation when customers call `redwood.init()` in sampleapps. Also update quickstart docs to call `request-id` before `@opentelemetry/auto-instrument`.

maya: I'll open a hotfix PR for the loghook fallback + test and add redact allowlist config. pinging security for review of hashing approach.

ci-bot: maya opened PR #4899: "fix(loghook): fallback to header + redact allowlist for x-request-id; add hashing option" — CI queued. :white_check_mark:

security: acked the allowlist approach pending tests showing only hashed values stored when HASH_ALLOWLIST_HEADERS=1. Also please add a short section to the privacy design doc.

sam: I'll update the onboarding quickstart with a note: "If you use OTEL auto-instrumentation, install request-id middleware upstream (before) or enable REDACT_ALLOWLIST_HEADERS + HASH_ALLOWLIST_HEADERS in env."

maya: Will link PR and docs update once CI passes. Thanks everyone! :thumbsup:
